settlement: sale proceeds settle next observed regular session; no same-day reuse
cost_status: assumed, not verified broker fees or observed historical quotes

models.zone: numpy MLP 26-32-16-1 sigmoid, BTC pretrained then BITX fine-tuned
models.return: numpy MLP 26-32-16-3, BITX only, predicts 5/15/30 minute gross returns in percent

selection: Among 9 fixed horizon/zone-threshold policies with >=5 validation trades choose highest average validation daily PnL, else highest daily PnL of all; tie by fewer trades then earlier candidate. Record no-trade days.
pretraining_comparator: One same-architecture BITX-only scratch region model, same fine-tuning epochs, diagnostic only; never used to select or replace the primary model after test.
entry: Bullish OB first-touch at completed bar, predict positive net return and zone probability >= threshold; next bar open adverse fill; pre-entry invalidated zones skipped.
pressure: Evaluate bearish resistance separately; no short entries. Its current distance is also an input to long trades.
profit_gate: mean test daily trading PnL >= 200 AND every test session >=200 AND double-cost cumulative PnL>0; operating expenses unknown prevents full business-profit certification
